paper_title: TRUTH DECAY Quantifying Multi-Turn Sycophancy in Language Models
caption: entropyavggraphstatic.png
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the average entropy values achieved across sycophancy reduction methods when applied to static experiments using different AI models. The horizontal axis, labeled “Different AI Models,” displays the model names: GPT-4, Claude, and Llama, in left-to-right order. The vertical axis, labeled “Average Average Entropy Values,” is a linear scale ranging from approximately 3.0 to 6.0, with tick intervals of 0.5, and represents entropy values. The bar corresponding to GPT-4 is a dark red color and reaches a height of approximately 4.8, while the bar for Claude is a pale yellow and reaches a height of approximately 4.5. The Llama bar is light blue and has a height of approximately 3.8.  The bars are not sorted, and none of the bars appear to be visually emphasized.  The chart presents four distinct bars, each representing a different sycophancy reduction method: Baseline (dark red), Source (pale yellow), Direct Command (light blue), and GPT-Al Models (light blue).
